crosswalks.historical_boundary: K2/Bambandyanalo archaeological settlement (approximately five hectares) and the separately reported South African K2-phase settlement distribution in the Shashe-Limpopo Valley
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for K2 site locator; low for complete phase landscape

area_comparison.interpretation: The archaeological site lies inside the selected EU5 location, but the selector is more than five orders of magnitude larger. No area-weighting or extrapolation from the capital to the full location is permitted.

crosswalks.resolution_method: SANParks identifies K2/Bambandyanalo as a site near Mapungubwe Hill within the Mapungubwe Cultural Landscape; Huffman 2015 Fig. 3a maps the K2 settlement distribution in the Shashe-Limpopo Valley. The game location is used only as a containing selector for validation. The 1.0 value is containment coverage of the 0.05 km2 site, not equivalence of the historical settlement footprint and the EU5 location.
crosswalks.notes: This crosswalk intentionally does not assign the 3,763-person phase estimate to all of mapungubwe. Use only for site/landscape diagnostics and held-out settlement checks.
